questions.question: 78 is related to 69 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 57 is related to 48. To which of the following is 94 related to, following the same logic?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **Second number = (First number - 9)**

**78: 69**

→ 69 = (78 - 9)

**57: 48**

→ 48 = (57 - 9)

Similarly,

**94: ?**

→ ? = (94 - 9) = 85

Hence, the correct answer is **"85"**.

questions.question:
What will come in the place of '?' in the following equation, if '+' and '-' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

105 × 7 + 43 - 37 ÷ 3 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] 

Given equation: 105 × 7 + 43 - 37 ÷ 3 = ?

Now if '+' and '-' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged then:

⇒ __**105 ÷ 7**__ - 43 + 37 × 3 = ?

⇒ 15 - 43 + __**37 × 3**__ = ?

⇒ __**15**__ - 43 __**+ 111**__ = ?

⇒ **__126__**__ - 43__ = **83.**

Hence, the correct answer is *'Option 2'*.

questions.question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

**Statements:** All cars are cats. All fans are cats.

**Conclusions:**

(I) All cars are fans.

(II) Some fans are cars.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Statements:

All cars are cats.

All fans are cats.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b65683bf44d6322cdcdd1c0cdf6028f25b8f838b3babb571d2935a4c18bec194.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All cars are fans → **False** (There is no direct relation is given between cars and fans. So, it can be possible only.)

II. Some fans are cars → **False** (There is no direct relation is given between fans and cars. So, it can be possible only.)

So, **neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 3'.***

questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if '+' and '-' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' and are interchanged?

29 ÷ 6 + 5 - 98 × 2 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] 

Given equation : 29 ÷ 6 + 5 - 98 × 2 = ?

Now if '+' and '-' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged then:

⇒ 29 × 6 - 5 + __**98 ÷ 2**__ = ?

⇒ __29 × 6__ - 5 + 49 = ?

⇒ __**174**__ - 5 __**+ 49**__ = ?

⇒ __**223 - 5**__ = **218**.

Hence, the correct answer is *'Option 3'*.
